verdict.rationale: Live probes confirm Deel serves an llms.txt at developer.deel.com/llms.txt with HTTP 200. Its docs also offer clean Markdown for any page by appending .md, plus a complete documentation index. The many cited docs URLs ending in .md show these agent-oriented pages are in real use. Missing for 10: confirmation the llms.txt content is clean, since the probe shows an embedded HTML stylesheet link; no evidence of an llms-full.txt or first-party guidance on pointing agents at these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: For clean Markdown of any page, append .md to the page URL.
